scope: CVG-002B2a durable synthetic PIX request and fenced dispatcher core

criteria.limitations: Only the explicitly non-production synthetic outbound boundary is verified; signed inbound, B1 settlement consumption, SPA and real providers are excluded.

criteria.description: Tenant authority, RLS, composed foreign keys, rate limits, idempotency, timeout ambiguity, synthetic-provider production guards and regressions are current and passing.
criteria.limitations: This local verification is not provider homologation, production migration, deployment or release evidence.

criteria.description: Independent security and final T4 reviews found no remaining CRITICAL, HIGH or MEDIUM issue in the bounded B2a checkpoint.
criteria.limitations: Any expansion into B2b, B2c, external systems or production requires a new gate and new critique.

authority.scope: CVG-002B2a durable synthetic PIX request and fenced dispatcher core

authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate on schema, request, dispatcher, provider, worker composition or test-harness mutation and before any B2b/B2c, external or production use.
